name: Kamoke
registryAssessment: Official Punjab PLRA/PULSE and Municipal Committee Kamoke sources were evidenced. The PULSE public-user viewer exposes a Gujranwala cadastral map service that returned parcel polygons, but no city-scoped registry custodian or legally authoritative open parcel coverage was established; registryFound remains null.

queries.query: Kamoke Punjab Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records PLRA
queries.result: Found the official Punjab Land Records Authority, the public-user PULSE urban land viewer, the Municipal Committee Kamoke maps page, and an official Kamoke base-map PDF whose legend includes parcel boundaries. PULSE JavaScript exposed the current Punjab cadastral ArcGIS route; no separate Kamoke-specific cadastral endpoint was found.

queries.query: کاموکی پنجاب پاکستان سرکاری اراضی ریکارڈ نقشہ پارسل
queries.result: Search returned the official Urdu-facing Punjab online Fard/LRMIS route and Punjab land-record references, but no Urdu-specific Kamoke parcel API. The public PULSE viewer remained the only current first-party route exposing anonymous parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement public-user viewer
officialSources.observation: Current viewer HTML/JavaScript provides a Continue as Public User path and references the Punjab_Cdastral_Maps ArcGIS service; it states the map is indicative and not a legal boundary.

officialSources.role: Punjab PLRA GIS Gujranwala cadastral layer
officialSources.observation: Anonymous app-issued token request allowed metadata access; layer name is Gujranwala, geometry is polygon, source spatial reference is WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857, and safe native fields include OBJECTID and Khasra_ID.

officialSources.role: Municipal Committee Kamoke official maps page
officialSources.observation: Lists current municipal service maps and an official base map; this is a local municipal map custodian, not proof of a cadastral registry service.
Official February 2023 PDF covers Kamoke and labels a Parcel Boundary legend, but it is a rendered map without native parcel IDs or full machine-readable parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: Punjab Land Records Authority official portal
officialSources.observation: Official provincial land-record authority and service context; no city-specific parcel-vector endpoint was exposed by the landing page.

geometryDecision.reason: A bounded anonymous query against the official Gujranwala cadastral layer returned three full polygon geometries with native OBJECTID identities. The exact WUP point query returned zero features; this is recorded as an exact-point miss and not as evidence of citywide absence. Khasra_ID returned 0 for the sampled features, so it was not used as identity.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Punjab PULSE/PLRA Gujranwala cadastral layer plus Municipal Committee Kamoke map references.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The Gujranwala layer is publicly queryable through the PULSE public-user route, but the response was bounded around Kamoke and does not prove complete citywide coverage or legal boundary authority.

sourceFieldMapping.nativeIdentityEvidence: ArcGIS layer metadata declares OBJECTID as the object ID field; Khasra_ID was observed but returned 0 in all retained samples and was not retained.
sourceFieldMapping.sourceCrs: EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857); query was requested with outSR=4326 for retained GeoJSON
